dev: Reuse the original 15 dev questions unchanged; original 5 test questions are not used for tuning or fresh holdout reporting.
holdout: Ten new questions about different facts/pages in chapters 9-10, epilogue, and bonus story. Written and source-verified before candidate development or evaluation. Do not run holdout retrieval until selection is locked.
authorship: AI-authored convenience sample, exact quote existence checked in original and prepared pages; independent human validation pending.

candidate_plan.baseline_C: Original paragraph 500-character chunks with optional section filter
candidate_plan.D: Sentence-aware 1000-character windows, 250-character overlap; same embedding model and optional section filter
candidate_plan.E: Same D chunks; dense plus PostgreSQL English full-text retrieval, reciprocal-rank fusion k=60, depth=30 per retriever
candidate_plan.F: Same E candidate pool; local Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 cross-encoder reranks up to 30 fused candidates

selection_rule: simpler method in fixed order baseline_C,D,E,F
bounds: One predeclared context size and overlap, one fusion setting and one reranker. No tuning on fresh holdout. Skip more complex candidates only if a simpler candidate is perfect on both dev metrics.
metric: Original unchanged strict document/page/full-evidence-quote containment metric. No new evidence alternatives or relaxed scoring.
fair_comparison: Evaluate original baseline C and dev-selected candidate on exactly the same new ten test questions. Preserve original v1 data and result artifacts.
old_test_status: Original five-question holdout was already viewed. Any later old-test result is a diagnostic only, not an independent improvement claim.
